limitations: Synthetic household, prescriptions, stores, drug plans and cards only; no real people, brands, patient data or payment data. Clinical facts are short paraphrases of cited public drug labels.
The App records facts, statuses, pharmacist notes and consequences; it makes no clinical decisions and does not rank options.

Member-facing business GUI on the shared local Web Host (gui/) for the account holder; no pharmacist, prescriber or plan screens, whose actions arrive as scenario events, and no page route for user confirmations, which Infra applies.

Time is the environment's: no clock event and no scheduler. Review, scheduled resubmission, pickup warning, return to stock and prescription expiry are due times on each record, applied from the supplied virtual time.
No attachments or media: resources are not used.
